edges.when: An active air-drying run exists and this household/task has not been dismissed
edges.effect: Open the exact run check; no dryness is recorded

edges.when: Dismiss this household/task on this device
edges.effect: Hide this reminder and focus main; care state and Home/Laundry access remain

edges.when: The task's run, stage or piece count differs from the dismissed task
edges.effect: A different task may appear again; the fixture provides a declared run/count change

edges.when: A new active air run differs from the dismissed task
edges.effect: Carry the changed run ID to its check; preserve care state

edges.when: Leave the check without confirming dryness
edges.effect: Keep the run and any unsaved check inputs

edges.when: Leave the drying list without unsaved checks
edges.effect: No transfer, dryness or dismissal is undone

edges.when: Transfer has succeeded and the washed pieces are in the drying queue
edges.returnTo: Laundry shows the queued pieces; Back does not undo the transfer

edges.when: An untransferred 20-item load remains in the declared synthetic plan
edges.effect: Retain the original item IDs and any completed wash

edges.when: This load has finished washing and the synthetic condition permits writes
edges.effect: Transfer this load's original 20 items once; retain every other load

edges.when: Leave the wash screen without resetting the family run
edges.effect: Retain this load's completed wash and the existing drying queue

edges.when: Selected pieces belong to a retained drying run and writes are available
edges.effect: Mark only selected pieces dry; keep the damp remainder drying

edges.when: An untransferred family load remains
edges.effect: Keep drying runs and unsaved selections while opening the next load

edges.when: Leave drying without resetting the family run
edges.effect: Keep the same items, runs and put-away history

edges.when: All selected IDs are currently dry and writes are available
edges.effect: Mark those original textiles clean; keep unselected and damp pieces

edges.when: An untransferred family load remains
edges.effect: Retain the put-away selection and all drying state
